name: 60647 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60647 (Chicago) has 263 nonprofit organizations. 117 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60647 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
